source_work: Philippe Cornu, Tibetan Astrology, English translation Hamish Gregor, Shambhala 1997
scope: printed pp102-119, two-up scanned PDF pages58-66; original scans read for method passages

source_notes.paraphrase: Cornu presents the nine-number mewa Lo Shu square with all eight straight rows, columns and diagonals summing to 15, and places the squares in the directions of the compass.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: The numbers 1,6,8 are white metal, 2 black water, 3 blue water, 4 green wood, 5 yellow earth, 7,9 red fire, each also assigned a direction.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: Cornu groups natal mewa by twelve-year animals: Tiger/Monkey/Pig/Snake admit 8,2,5; Rat/Horse/Bird/Hare admit 7,4,1; Ox/Sheep/Dog/Dragon admit 9,6,3.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: The annual natal mewa sequence comprises three distinct sixty-year rounds in a 180-year cycle, starting with White One, Green Four, and Red Seven respectively in Wood Rat years.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: With natal mewa in the middle of its Lo Shu square, vitality is in the southwestern cell, personal power northeastern cell, and body the central natal mewa.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: In Cornu's worked Earth Dog 1958 example, natal/body mewa White Six maps to vitality Blue Three and power Red Nine.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: Cornu derives the windhorse mewa of Wood Rat year 1984 (Red Seven natal) from Wood Tiger's vitality mewa, yielding White Eight.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: Cornu states the natal mewa of each sexagenary 60-year round corresponds to the vitality or power mewa of other rounds; this is cycle correspondence, not empirical corroboration.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: For simple annual Parkha movement Cornu explicitly uses the person's sex; men's cycle starts Li and runs clockwise, women's starts Kham and runs counterclockwise.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: Cornu gives the male sequence Li,Khon,Da,Khen,Kham,Kin,Tsin,Zon and the reverse female sequence Kham,Khen,Da,Khon,Li,Zon,Tsin,Kin, stating that the series meet in Da years.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: The text associates mewa Red9=Li, Black2=Khon, Red7=Da, White6=Khen, White1=Kham, White8=Kin, Blue3=Tsin, Green4=Zon; Yellow5 is central/unassigned.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: In contrast to its annual parkha method, Cornu explicitly makes Papme rotation depend on masculine versus feminine natal YEAR polarity, not the sex of the person.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: For masculine natal-year Papme, begin with natal mewa at age one, move toward the eastern cell (printed diagram left), then turn left and continue around the square.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: For feminine natal-year Papme, again start at center and the East cell, but then turn right and continue around the square; the text makes no reference to natal subject's sex as a route switch.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: For a person born in 1956 Fire Monkey, a masculine year, Cornu's worked four first Papme values are 8,6,2,4.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_notes.paraphrase: For a person born in 1957 Fire Bird, a feminine year, Cornu's worked four first Papme values are 7,5,6,2.
source_notes.status: Cornu's modern synthesis; not primary Tibetan original

source_conflict_with_older_Erlewine: Cornu Papme traversal is switched by birth-year polarity, not person's sex; Erlewine pp309–310 says men/women. These are not the same method. No resolution by selecting favorable charts.
Cornu annual Parkha progression, unlike his Papme, does explicitly use subject sex.
source_differences: Cornu presentation includes I Ching Chinese-derived features; do not treat as independent corroboration of BaZi.
